title: Istara Living Feature Documentation
description: Code-evidence-backed inventory for generated researcher and engineering feature documentation. Feature paths mirror the current Istara navigation, tabs, and major sub-surfaces.

features.title: Application Navigation
features.summary: The main shell organizes Istara into primary, secondary, utility, and mobile navigation surfaces and routes each selected view into the mounted work area.

features.title: Project Switcher
features.summary: The sidebar project control lists available projects and lets users create, select, pause, resume, or delete the active project context used by most Istara views.

features.title: Global Search
features.summary: The shell exposes a command/search modal from the sidebar and keyboard shortcut so users can find navigable work surfaces and project objects.

features.title: Notification Bell
features.summary: The sidebar notification bell polls unread notification counts and links users into the notifications surface.

features.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.summary: HomeClient wires global shortcuts for search, view switching, shortcut help, and right-panel toggling.

features.title: View Onboarding
features.summary: Reusable onboarding overlays and tour state introduce major Istara views and offer context-specific chat prompts.

features.title: Login And Session Bootstrap
features.summary: The application shell checks authentication state, shows the login surface when needed, and loads session state before mounting protected views.

features.title: Chat Workspace
features.summary: Chat is the project-scoped conversational workspace for working with Istara agents, context, files, and model settings.

features.title: Chat Sessions
features.summary: The chat session sidebar manages project-scoped conversation history and new session creation.

features.title: Chat Model Controls
features.summary: Chat exposes model, thinking, and reasoning controls so users can tune how the assistant responds within the configured local or server-backed model environment.

features.title: Chat File Attachments
features.summary: Chat can attach uploaded project files and documents so the conversation can use project evidence and user-provided material.

features.title: Chat Audio Conversation
features.summary: The chat audio flow records user speech through the browser, sends it to the voice route, and returns transcription or voice-assisted chat input.

features.title: Chat Steering
features.summary: Steering controls collect lightweight user guidance that can shape downstream assistant behavior and project context.

features.title: Findings Evidence
features.summary: The Findings evidence tab lists research insights and recommendations for the active project and supports phase-oriented review.

features.title: Findings Phase Tabs
features.summary: The Evidence view segments findings by Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver project phases.

features.title: Findings Codebook
features.summary: The Codebook tab surfaces qualitative coding structures and codebook versions associated with project findings.

features.title: Findings Code Review
features.summary: The Review tab presents code review queues for validating and adjudicating qualitative coding work.

features.title: Project Reports
features.summary: The Reports tab lets users generate, inspect, and manage project reports produced from findings and research evidence.

features.title: Report Slide Instructions
features.summary: Report-related surfaces support presentation or slide guidance that can carry research findings into communicable report artifacts.

features.title: UX Laws Catalog
features.summary: The UX Laws catalog gives researchers a structured reference for applying UX laws to research and design interpretation.

features.title: UX Laws Compliance
features.summary: The compliance tab checks or summarizes how project work aligns with selected UX laws.

features.title: Task Kanban Board
features.summary: Tasks presents project work as a Kanban board for tracking research operations, agent work, and review handoffs.

features.title: Task Editor
features.summary: The task editor creates and updates task details, assignments, status, and task-linked research context.

features.title: Human Task Review
features.summary: Review actions support approving, requesting revision, or otherwise resolving human-in-the-loop task work.

features.title: Task Attachments
features.summary: Tasks can reference project files or documents so research work stays connected to the evidence it depends on.

features.title: Send Task To Report
features.summary: Task surfaces can move validated task outputs toward report generation or reporting workflows.

features.title: Interview Files
features.summary: The Interviews view manages interview recordings and source files for participant research analysis.

features.title: Interview Transcription
features.summary: Interview audio processing uses backend transcription capabilities to turn recordings into usable research text.

features.title: Interview Preview And Tags
features.summary: Interview preview parts display file previews, send-to-agent actions, and tag creation controls.

features.title: Document Library
features.summary: Documents centralizes project documents and makes source material available for preview, chat, and analysis workflows.

features.title: Document Upload
features.summary: Upload controls import project files and documents into Istara for downstream reading, chat, and evidence workflows.

features.title: Document Preview
features.summary: Document preview lets users inspect uploaded project material before using it in chat, interviews, or findings workflows.

features.title: Document Suggestions
features.summary: Interactive suggestions surface possible next actions or edits for document-centered workflows.

features.title: Project Context Editor
features.summary: The Context view edits project background, goals, assumptions, and other structured context used by Istara workflows.

features.title: Skills Catalog
features.summary: The Skills catalog lists available capabilities agents can use or propose for research workflows.

features.title: Skill Proposals
features.summary: Skill proposal flows present candidate tool or capability changes for review before they are adopted.

features.title: Create Skill
features.summary: Create Skill supports adding or configuring a new skill surface from inside Istara.

features.title: Agent Registry
features.summary: The Agents view lists and manages available agents, including their status and project-facing roles.

features.title: Agent Detail Panels
features.summary: Selected agent details expose overview, identity, memory, and permission information for that agent.

features.title: Agent-To-Agent Log
features.summary: The A2A tab displays agent-to-agent communication or coordination events for operational visibility.

features.title: Agent Proposals
features.summary: Agent proposal workflows surface suggested agent changes or actions for review.

features.title: Create Agent
features.summary: Create Agent supports configuring new agents and their role-facing metadata.

features.title: Knowledge Memory
features.summary: The Memory knowledge tab manages project knowledge artifacts and retrieval material.

features.title: Agent Memory
features.summary: The Agent memory tab exposes memory tied to agent behavior and project collaboration.

features.title: Memory Health
features.summary: Memory health surfaces status and quality signals for memory or retrieval infrastructure.

features.title: Context DAG
features.summary: The Context DAG tab visualizes or inspects relationships across project context nodes.

features.title: Interface Design Chat
features.summary: Design Chat is the conversational starting point for generating, refining, and reasoning about interface concepts.

features.title: Generate Interfaces
features.summary: The Generate tab creates interface assets or screen proposals from project context and design prompts.

features.title: Screens Gallery
features.summary: Screens displays generated interface screens and previews for review.

features.title: Configuration
features.summary: The Configuration tab connects interface work with design-tool setup, including Figma-oriented import or export flows.

features.title: Interface Handoff
features.summary: Handoff packages interface outputs into developer-facing specifications or exportable artifacts.

features.title: Findings Picker
features.summary: The Findings Picker lets interface workflows reference insights and recommendations from the Findings area.

features.title: Integrations Overview
features.summary: The Integrations overview summarizes connected channels, deployment surfaces, and integration health.

features.title: Messaging Integrations
features.summary: Messaging connects external conversation channels such as team or participant messaging tools into Istara.

features.title: Survey Integrations
features.summary: Surveys configures participant question and survey collection flows connected to project research.

features.title: MCP Integrations
features.summary: The MCP tab configures Model Context Protocol server access, policies, and audit visibility.

features.title: Research Deployments
features.summary: Deployments configure participant-facing research deployments and link them to channels, questions, findings, and timeline views.

features.title: Deployment Dashboard
features.summary: The deployment dashboard has sub-tabs for live status, questions, participants, findings, channels, and timeline activity.

features.title: Loops Overview
features.summary: Loops overview summarizes automated and scheduled research loop health.

features.title: Loop Schedules
features.summary: Schedules configure recurring loop timing, including cron-style recurrence controls.

features.title: Agent Loops
features.summary: Agent Loops connects recurring work with configured agents and their automated research responsibilities.

features.title: Custom Loops
features.summary: Custom loops provide a surface for user-defined recurring or automated research actions.

features.title: Loop Execution History
features.summary: Execution History records loop runs, outcomes, and recent automation activity.

features.title: System Status And Models
features.summary: Settings shows backend, LLM, hardware, model recommendation, and available model status for the local installation.

features.title: LLM Server Settings
features.summary: Settings manages configured LLM providers, server endpoints, provider labels, and active model switching.

features.title: User Management
features.summary: User management supports team member visibility and administrative user operations.

features.title: Connection Strings
features.summary: Connection string settings provide governed admin-only configuration for sensitive external or local service connection data.

features.title: Passkeys And Two-Factor Authentication
features.summary: Settings includes passkey and TOTP management for strengthening account authentication.

features.title: Active Sessions
features.summary: Session management lists active authentication sessions and supports session-level control.

features.title: Software Updates
features.summary: The update checker surfaces available Istara software updates from the settings view.

features.title: Governed Evolution
features.summary: Governed Evolution displays proposals, archive, reasoning, and contract information for controlled system self-improvement.

features.title: Compute Donation
features.summary: Compute donation lets a browser session contribute local compute capacity under controlled limits.

features.title: Project Settings
features.summary: Project Settings configure project-specific metadata and operational preferences separate from global system settings.

features.title: Autoresearch Dashboard
features.summary: The Autoresearch dashboard summarizes automated research experiment status and recent results.

features.title: Autoresearch Experiments
features.summary: Experiments configure and inspect automated research runs across strategies or parameters.

features.title: Autoresearch Leaderboard
features.summary: The leaderboard ranks automated research experiment outcomes for comparison.

features.title: Autoresearch Configuration
features.summary: Autoresearch configuration sets parameters for automated research strategies and runs.

features.title: Compute Pool
features.summary: Compute Pool provides operational visibility into available compute nodes, routing, and local or pooled execution capacity.

features.title: Ensemble Health
features.summary: Ensemble Health surfaces health and consensus signals for Istara's multi-model or multi-agent ensemble behavior.

features.title: Quality Dashboard
features.summary: Quality Dashboard summarizes system quality, validation, and operational signals for the running Istara installation.

features.title: Backup
features.summary: Backup provides project or system backup controls and status for preserving Istara data.

features.title: Meta-Agent
features.summary: The Meta-Agent surface exposes the meta-hyperagent system for inspecting or governing higher-level agentic improvement behavior.

features.title: Admin Dashboard
features.summary: The Admin dashboard provides administrator-only operational controls and visibility.

features.title: Version History
features.summary: History lists project or artifact version events for traceability and recovery.

features.title: Notifications List
features.summary: Notifications lists system and project notifications with read/unread state.

features.title: Notification Preferences
features.summary: Notification preferences let users configure which notifications they receive and how notification categories are handled.
